persona: Undergraduate assistant collecting weekly field measurements from a 4-treatment maize trial, recording observations as a CSV time series.
source_style: field notebook + handheld measurements recorded into a CSV file each week

columns.name: Plant_Height_cm
columns.notes: height in cm, some blank cells (missing measurements)

columns.name: Chlorophyll_SPAD
columns.notes: SPAD meter reading (unitless proxy for chlorophyll)

columns.name: Disease_Incidence_Percent
columns.notes: % of plant affected, increases late season

columns.name: Observations
columns.notes: free-form field notes; blank for most rows

clean_table: First 4 rows: [{'Week': 1, 'Date': '2024-04-01', 'Treatment_ID': 'T1_NoInput', 'Plant_Height_cm': 17.2, 'Leaf_Area_Index': 0.62, 'Stem_Diameter_mm': 3.8, 'Chlorophyll_SPAD': 27, 'Disease_Incidence_Percent': 0, 'Observations': ''}, {'Week': 1, 'Date': '2024-04-01', 'Treatment_ID': 'T2_LowN', 'Plant_Height_cm': 18.1, 'Leaf_Area_Index': 0.68, 'Stem_Diameter_mm': 3.9, 'Chlorophyll_SPAD': 30, 'Disease_Incidence_Percent': 0, 'Observations': ''}, ...]; last 2 rows (week 15): [{'Week': 15, 'Date': '2024-07-08', 'Treatment_ID': 'T3_MedN', 'Plant_Height_cm': 201.5, 'Leaf_Area_Index': 3.14, 'Stem_Diameter_mm': 17.8, 'Chlorophyll_SPAD': 48, 'Disease_Incidence_Percent': 8.2, 'Observations': ''}, {'Week': 15, 'Date': '2024-07-08', 'Treatment_ID': 'T4_HighN', 'Plant_Height_cm': 210.3, 'Leaf_Area_Index': 3.29, 'Stem_Diameter_mm': 18.9, 'Chlorophyll_SPAD': 51, 'Disease_Incidence_Percent': 5.8, 'Observations': ''}]; n=60 total (4 treatments × 15 weeks); height grows ~2.5 cm/week with nitrogen effect (+0.15 factor per treatment level); LAI plateau ~3.0; disease increases weeks 9–15.
intended_analysis: Trajectory analysis: do growth curves differ significantly among treatments? Mixed model with week + treatment effects. Time-to-flowering (week 5 for T3, T4). Disease progression model. Recovery from week-10 waterlogging stress. Treatment ranking by final height and LAI.
mess_applied: two missing numeric values (blank cells: week 6 T1 height, week 12 T4 LAI)
free-form observation text with occasional typos or abbreviations
observations column mostly blank, populated only at key events
CSV format (not Excel) requires different parsing
date format YYYY-MM-DD is consistent but parsing must recognize it
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong: Blank cells in numeric columns could be interpreted as zero or silently dropped. Time-series analysis without accounting for the week variable or unequal spacing will be misleading. Missing observations (week 6, week 12) and event notes (week 10 rain, week 13 senescence) add context a simple mean-per-treatment misses.
